name: Turkey Bolognese
desc: Quick ground turkey Bolognese with carrots, red wine, crushed tomatoes, and a splash of whole milk, over tagliatelle.

source.title: Turkey Bolognese
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts, down to the 93 percent lean turkey note and the extra can of crushed tomatoes as a wine substitute, and the same one-skillet method with a 10 min simmer.

ingredients.raw: 3 medium carrots, peeled and finely chopped (about 1 1/4 cups)
1 small yellow onion, finely chopped (about 1 cup)
1 lb ground turkey (93% lean; avoid 99% lean) or ground chicken
ingredients.note: 93% lean; avoid 99% lean; or ground chicken

ingredients.raw: 1 cup dry red wine, such as Cabernet Sauvignon (or 1 more 14.5 oz can crushed tomatoes)
ingredients.note: such as Cabernet Sauvignon, or 1 more 14.5 oz can crushed tomatoes

ingredients.raw: 1/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan, for serving
2 tbsp chopped fresh basil and/or parsley, for serving

steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the carrots, onion, salt, and pepper and cook until the vegetables begin to soften, 5-7 min.
Raise the heat to medium-high, add the turkey, and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it starts to brown, about 3 min.
Stir in the garlic, oregano, and red pepper flakes and cook until fragrant, about 1 min.
Pour in the wine and scrape up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Stir in the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, and milk.
Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer until slightly thickened and the turkey is cooked through (165°F), about 10 min. Taste and add more salt, pepper, or pepper flakes.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta until al dente. Drain.
Top the pasta with the sauce and serve sprinkled with Parmesan and basil or parsley.
